sources.title: GitHub - deepgrove-ai/Bonsai
sources.snippet: Bonsai is a small 500 million parameter ternary weight language model trained by deepgrove. Bonsai adopts the Llama architecture and Mistral tokenizer following Danube 3, with modified linear layers to support ternary weights. The model has been trained primarily using DCLM-Pro and Fineweb-Edu. Bonsai marks a new paradigm of efficiency, being trained in less than 5 billion tokens.
